/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-helm-app-template-redi.doc:
Redis is an open-source, in-memory data structure store that is used as a database, cache, and message broker. It provides a fast and flexible solution for storing and retrieving data, making it an ideal choice for a wide range of use cases, including real-time analytics, session management, and more.

Redis is used by Authentik, Authelia, oauth2-proxy.

        <level>warning</level>

    <skip_check_for_incorrect_settings>1</skip_check_for_incorrect_settings>

    <listen_host>0.0.0.0</listen_host>

    <query_thread_log remove="remove"/>
    <query_log remove="remove"/>
    <text_log remove="remove"/>
    <trace_log remove="remove"/>
    <metric_log remove="remove"/>
    <asynchronous_metric_log remove="remove"/>
    <session_log remove="remove"/>
    <part_log remove="remove"/>
    <latency_log remove="remove"/>

    <!-- Disable OpenTelemetry and other problematic system tables -->
    <opentelemetry_span_log remove="remove"/>
    <processors_profile_log remove="remove"/>

    <background_pool_size>25</background_pool_size>

<clickhouse>
    <!-- Define users -->
    <users>
        <!-- Leave default user as-is by not specifying any settings for it -->

        <!-- Create a new user named clickhouse -->
        <clickhouse>
            <!-- Password in plain text -->
            <password>clickhouse</password>

            <!-- Allow connections from any IP -->
            <networks>
                <ip>::/0</ip>
            </networks>

            <!-- Assign profile and quota -->
            <profile>default</profile>
            <quota>default</quota>

            <!-- Grant administrative privileges -->
            <access_management>1</access_management>
        </clickhouse>
    </users>

    <!-- User profiles -->
    <profiles>
        <default>
            <log_queries>0</log_queries>
            <log_query_threads>0</log_query_threads>
            <max_memory_usage>8589934592</max_memory_usage>
            <max_memory_usage_for_user>8589934592</max_memory_usage_for_user>
            <max_memory_usage_for_all_queries>8589934592</max_memory_usage_for_all_queries>
            <background_merges_mutations_concurrency_ratio>1</background_merges_mutations_concurrency_ratio>
        </default>
    </profiles>

    <!-- Quotas -->
    <quotas>
        <default>
        </default>
    </quotas>
</clickhouse>

ops=(
  "db:add-missing-primary-keys"
  "db:add-missing-indices"
  "db:add-missing-columns"
  "files:cleanup"
)
grey="\e[1;30m"
reset="\e[0m"
green="\e[1;32m"
red="\e[1;31m"
for op in "$${ops[@]}" ; do
  echo -e "$${grey}Running php occ $op $reset"
  su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ $op && echo -en "$green" || echo -en "$red"
  echo -e "Finished php occ $op $reset"
done &&
echo -e "$${grey}Running php occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive $reset"
su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive && echo -en "$green" || echo -en "$red"
echo -e "Finished php occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive $reset"
while :; do /cron.sh; done

chmod +x /var/www/html/custom_apps/notify_push/bin/x86_64/notify_push && \
while :; do su www-data \
  -s /var/www/html/custom_apps/notify_push/bin/x86_64/notify_push -- \
  /var/www/html/config/config.php; sleep 1; done &
pid=$!
grey="\e[1;30m"
reset="\e[0m"
green="\e[1;32m"
red="\e[1;31m"
echo -e "$${grey}Waiting a few seconds for services to start$${reset}"
sleep 10
echo -e "$${grey}Testing if push app is configured"
op="notify_push:setup https://cloud.${personal_domain}/push"
while ! su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ "notify_push:self-test"; do
  echo -e "$${grey}Self-test failed, running php occ $op $reset"
  if ! su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ $op; then
    echo -e "$${red}$${op} operation failed, retrying...$${reset}"
    sleep 5
  fi
done
echo -e "$${green}Test passed$${reset}"
wait $pid
